verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into an up Riposte or let her double-Lunge poke you down before level 6; you win from level 3 onward once Ground Slam starts shredding her attack speed and sustain.

brief.thesis: Fiora's entire kit runs on landing autos — Duelist stacks off hits, Burst of Speed's move speed procs off attacks and Lunges, and Riposte punishes you for attacking into it. Malphite's E (Ground Slam) cuts her attack speed on a 7s cooldown and his Q (Seismic Shard) steals her movement speed on an 8s cooldown, which directly denies the two things her damage and kiting depend on. Malphite in this matchup wins 55.6% over 2,716 games with both lane and solo-kill advantage, so this is a comfortable lane as long as you don't feed her Riposte free autos.

theirWindow.what: She can dash in, hit you, and dash out again within a couple seconds at no mana cost before you can punish. Don't facecheck into trades when her Q icon shows a recast window — hold Seismic Shard to slow her retreat the moment she commits the first dash.

yourWindow.when: right after she uses Riposte (10-6s CD)
yourWindow.what: Her parry is down for 10/9/8/7/6s depending on rank. Walk up and trade autos plus E (Ground Slam) freely — she has no way to punish an auto-attack trade until Riposte comes back off cooldown.

powerCurve.note: Ground Slam online, her Lunge CD still long
armor items crush her AD scaling

start.why: 73.7% pick rate at 55.1% win rate — the mana sustain lets you spam Q (8s CD) and E (7s CD) every time she walks up without running dry before your first back.

boots.why: 86.3% pick at 55% win rate. Her entire damage profile is basic-attack and Lunge-impact physical damage, so flat auto-attack reduction is the correct boots almost every game.

core.why: Grievous Wounds directly cuts her Duelist passive heal-per-hit, which is the one thing propping up her sustain in extended trades.
Passive AoE burn adds free damage on top of your Ground Slam shred while you keep stacking armor.
More Grievous Wounds plus the highest armor value in the build — this is the item that makes her autos feel pointless.
Completes the 62.7% win rate core (9.2% pick) — the attack speed slow aura compounds with your E shred to make her feel like she's fighting in mud.

situational.when: she's building toward a burst all-in with her jungler and you need a magic shield reset instead of Frozen Heart
you're already ahead and want your Unstoppable Force engage to one-shot squishies in skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: 56.7% win rate at 19.8% pick — Grasp's sustain and bonus health win the extended poke war against a champion whose only win condition is landing repeated autos on you.

summoners.why: 73.2% pick at 54% win rate — Teleport lets you shove with Brutal Strikes (W), recall for your armor item spikes, and return before she can scale her Lunge cooldown down. Flash+Ignite (55.5% win rate, 24.8% pick) is the alternative if you want to force early kills off your level 3-5 power spike instead of scaling.

playing.title: Punish Lunge whiffs with Q
playing.detail: The instant she dashes in with Q (Lunge) and misses or disengages, fire Seismic Shard to steal her movement speed before she can reset distance.

playing.title: Track Riposte, don't feed it
playing.detail: Never auto-attack into an up W (Riposte) — it boosts her AD and reflects magic damage back at you. Wait for the 10-6s window after she uses it to re-engage.

playing.title: Lead trades with Ground Slam
playing.detail: E (Ground Slam) on cooldown denies her attack speed, which starves both her Duelist passive stacking and her E (Burst of Speed) move speed procs.

playing.title: Pop Brutal Strikes before all-ins
playing.detail: Activate W for the armor and AD buff before committing to a fight — the attack buff plus hitting everything in front of you turns minion wave trades into free value.

playing.title: Check her W before ulting
playing.detail: Riposte can parry your R (Unstoppable Force) engage. Confirm her W is down before committing your 130/115/100/80/80s cooldown ultimate.

playing.title: Deny wall resets on her Blade Waltz
playing.detail: In skirmishes, don't let her land uncontested hits near walls where she can chain her R (Blade Waltz) dashes for free Duelist stacks.

playing.title: Rush Bramble Vest
playing.detail: Getting Grievous Wounds online first in your core directly undercuts her passive sustain before she can out-heal your poke.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and win rate numbers are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the matchup reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the ability interactions.
